analyst_view.overall: Third against fourth, one point apart: Freiburg (22) have won six in a row in all competitions, the latest 2-1 against Twente in the Conference League on Thursday with a stoppage-time winner, and Leipzig (21) beat Union 5-1 and Lens 3-1 in the Champions League. Julian Schuster made six changes for Twente, so several Freiburg starters are fresher than the three days' rest suggests; Florent Muslija is out (counted), and an earlier report of a Berkay Yilmaz suspension could not be confirmed. Leipzig miss Castello Lukeba (knee, confirmed by Martin Demichelis; Maxime Estève should partner Orban), Marc Guiu (close to a return but still out) and Assan Ouédraogo, all of which the numbers count. Benjamin Brand referees (counted). News for this match was thin (no full preview could be read), and nothing found moves the numbers, so I stay with them.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.5 goals, high for this fixture because Leipzig have scored 21 in their last six, and they already add 6% to Freiburg for Lukeba's absence. Freiburg have mostly won tight games and allowed only 5 in six, which the numbers partly count, while both sides have had busy weeks. Nothing new points clearly either way, so I stay at 3.5.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.9 corners, evenly split, and already count both sides' recent corner form. Freiburg's wide play through Beste and Scherhant and Leipzig's through Nusa (back from international duty, tired but fit) and Raum is what the numbers have seen all season, so I stay at 8.9.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.6 cards, already adding about 9% for Freiburg's 15 bookings in six and trimming for Leipzig's calmer record, plus a little for Brand (4.0 a game). It is a top-four game rather than a grudge match, so I stay at 3.6.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.5 shots, already a little lower for Freiburg and higher for Leipzig after their 110 shots in six. Freiburg rotated on Thursday and Leipzig had Tuesday's Champions League game, so neither side looks clearly more tired than the numbers allow; I stay at 26.5.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.6 shots on target and already add 5% for Leipzig's sharp finishing (46 on target in six). Guiu's absence is counted and he is not yet ready, and Estève in for Lukeba is a like-for-like change, so I stay at 9.6.
